build.overlap: Same precompiled Hermes -O bytecode on all hosts

clock: All hosts use __now(). Native before/after rebuilt with identical console-only steady_clock patch. Sub-millisecond monotonic clock checks pass. Historical native timings used Date.now fallback; low-percent differences should be assessed within this paired run.
order: Three complete 33-case overlap invocations plus canonical and isolated Locale controls per host. Rounds 1 and 3 before/after/magrinj; round 2 reverses. No builds or profiling during timings.
outputChecks: 342 values checked (297 overlap, 27 canonical tag controls, 18 isolated Locale controls). All FormatJS before/after values match; all controls match all hosts. Only overlap comparator differences: omitted/unsupported ListFormat default locale en-US versus en.
change: Retain the standard-decimal numeric part buffer, borrow long-style relative field keys, and move owned number parts into the last relative-pattern slot. Repeated earlier slots borrow.

probeStages.before: Baseline product with same probe source
probeStages.stage2: Also transfer owned relative number parts

probeLimits: Allocation/reallocation calls counted with a separate instrumented allocator, 10000 calls per case. Timing uses the uninstrumented optimized binary, 100000 calls per case. Single diagnostic runs; full Hermes runs are authoritative.

conformance.gates: 13 focused gates pass: Rust NumberFormat/RTF core and differential tests; Hermes NumberFormat/RTF/DateTimeFormat/DurationFormat source and bytecode; NumberFormat/RTF Test262; pinned ICU4C/J/X RTF checks.
conformance.observableBehavior: Sign order and nonfinite values explicitly checked; existing repeated numeric slots and empty named forms retained.
conformance.consumer: Nine SDK API smoke scripts pass.

limits: Several constructor and steady-state gaps remain. No whole-goal completion claim.

commands.benchmark: Build SDK and all three optimized workloads with Bazel; apply native-clock.patch to pinned standalone console host and rebuild both native variants with CMake; run each cquery workload on each optimized host.

treeNote: Shipping crates tree differs from measured tree only in the two crate READMEs. All measured product source hashes match.
